Cold start is a little fussy, however once it is started it's stable and passes all tests.

To start:
1. Run until science belts are filled and factory is idle
2. Turn on science consumption, wait for instability to appear
3. Stop consumption, wait for science belts to refill and factory to idle
4. Turn on consumption again, should now be stable.

It is unclocked as is not intended to win. I only submitted it to show the significant reduction in resource requirements when you build for max productivity. It also uses biochambers which require bioflux, and that is handled with an infinity chest. Spoilage is just burnt in a heating tower. Also, the initial nutrients are crafted with spoilage with is autoloaded a single time with an infinity chest (it reads if the system as 0 spoilage and loads a single inserter's worth to simulate manual loading all at once, but if anything fails, the system stores spoilage before sending it to be burnt, so this should only fire once).

Also, I did not include biter coal. I didn't really want to portray industrial animal abuse, and it's a silly idea anyway.
